title: Medusa core storefront and explicit checkout
summary: Original Medusa Store API adapter, product/cart components and serialized checkout with regional prices, ownership callbacks, provider allowlists and uncertain-outcome handling.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + React/ReactDOM 19.3.0; TypeScript build and seven fixture-transport/SSR tests covering regional price units, authorization-before-credentials, cart routes, payment-collection reuse, order sequencing and uncertain outcomes.
notes: No live Medusa service, payment session, purchase, email or provider challenge was performed; React 18 is peer-compatible but unexecuted.
Keep the HTTP adapter on the trusted server; the host supplies cart/session ownership, authenticated routes and an explicitly authorized payment-provider SDK flow.
Medusa binding covers MIT core only; Enterprise Edition and hosted services retain separate terms.
